title: Contact
lead: Ready to begin? Send a message below, and you'll receive a thoughtful reply by email.
formText: Share a little about what brings you here, and we'll take it from there — at a calm, unhurried pace.
privacyNote: Your name, email, and optional phone number are used only to schedule sessions and reply to you. This information is kept confidential and is never shared with third parties.
